topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I keep going over the conversation in my head, trying to find the moment it all fell apart. We met in the coffee shop, just like old times, but something was off. The way they laughed, too loud, too long. I mentioned the treehouse, the secret codes, and there was a pause, a flicker in their eyes. "I don't remember," they said, and my breath caught. I tried to laugh it off, to joke, but it felt like I was talking to a stranger. I left early, saying I had a thing, anything to end the awkwardness. It hurts, but I keep telling myself it's just a memory, a piece of my past that didn’t stick with them. It has to be okay, right?
